summary: Conditional Access exemption and temporary workstation staging for international new hire
description:
Issue summary: New international hire (engineering contractor) needs immediate access to VPC resources and a lab workstation. Conditional Access policy is blocking the SSO provisioning path; HR needs a temporary exception to complete onboarding.

Detailed: HR attempted to provision account via SCIM. SCIM returned a 409 due to an existing shadow account from previous contractor engagement; Azure AD conditional access requires MFA from corporate IPs and blocks legacy auth from outside office IPs. Device shipping timeline is constrained; contractor start date is next week.
impact: Onboarding delayed for one contractor; potential delay to feature delivery and mentoring schedule. Access to reserved GPU lab is blocked.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) HR submits SCIM create for user marisol.v-hire@example.com
2) SCIM API returns 409 "conflict: duplicate externalId".
3) Provisioning flow retries SAML assertion; conditional access returns 6: user blocked due to location/MFA policy.
4) Endpoint for device enrollment cannot complete due to blocked auth.
logs: SCIM response excerpts and AAD sign-in logs attached in Confluence link; sample error id: 0xA2C4 (SCIM409-conflict); AAD sign-in risk policy code: CA-LOC-403
investigation_notes: Checked SCIM: duplicate externalId linked to archived contractor account (last used 2024-09).
Azure AD sign-in logs show 'ConditionalAccessPolicy kt_office_only' triggered for sign-in from 203.0.113.45 (shipping vendor).
Device enrollment attempts fail because corp MDM challenge cannot be completed from vendor network.
Hypothesis: Shadow account prevents SCIM upsert; conditional access blocks token exchange for device enrollment.
resolution_notes: Workaround implemented: security approved a 48-hour conditional-access exception for the specific onboarding IP range and user principal name; network allowlist created in firewall (VPN-staging-APAC).
IT manually created a temporary service account and linked it to the contractor's laptop serial number for initial device enrollment. Manual KMS key access granted with timebox.
HR deactivated shadow externalId and we initiated a SCIM merge plan to consolidate records; longer-term automation ticket raised.
Follow-ups: Update onboarding runbook to include a conditional-access exception request template; add a pre-onboard SCIM duplicate-check step; schedule a change to reduce manual exceptions.
